# Completion Report — Work Order 6: MCP Pull Tools

## Status Summary

All checklist items for Work Order 6 have been implemented, verified, and tested within the strict boundary box (`internal/mcpserver/`).

### Implemented Tool Handlers & Definitions
1. [`HandleMemoryBrief`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L79-L130) (`memory.brief` / `memory_brief`):
   - Accepts [`MemoryBriefRequest`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L16-L18) `{ "scope": "string" }`.
   - Resolves aliases via `index.ResolveAlias`.
   - Filters to active entries, truncates text to 200 runes if needed, and formats brief summary.
   - Records exposure in [`Ledger.RecordPull`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/ledger.go).
2. [`HandleMemoryWhy`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L133-L212) (`memory.why` / `memory_why`):
   - Accepts [`MemoryWhyRequest`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L26-L28) `{ "entryId": "string" }`.
   - Fetches entry and history from index, formats rationale, evidence, anchors, verification status, timestamps, and history records.
   - Records exposure in `ledger.RecordPull`.
3. [`HandleMemoryHistory`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L215-L254) (`memory.history` / `memory_history`):
   - Accepts [`MemoryHistoryRequest`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L36-L38) `{ "scope": "string" }`.
   - Resolves aliases and queries history via `QueryHistoryByScope`.
   - Filters to retired/superseded entries and formats output.
   - Records exposure in `ledger.RecordPull`.
4. [`HandleMemorySearch`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L310-L346) (`memory.search` / `memory_search`):
   - Accepts [`MemorySearchRequest`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L46-L48) `{ "query": "string" }`.
   - Performs BM25 FTS5 search (`index.SearchEntries`), limits to top 10 results, formats ranked snippet output (max 100 runes).
   - Records exposure in `ledger.RecordPull`.
5. [`HandleMemoryNote`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L349-L415) (`memory.note` / `memory_note`):
   - Accepts [`MemoryNoteRequest`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L56-L60) `{ "scope": "string", "text": "string", "type": "string" }` (type defaults to `decision`).
   - Validates scope, text, and entry type against valid types.
   - Appends `ops.OpAdd` with `source: "agent"` via [`ops.Writer`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/writer.go) and syncs into index.
   - Returns formatted entry ID: `Note recorded: <entryID>`.

### Registration & Dispatching
- [`HandleMemoryAsk`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/server.go#L84-L110) marked deprecated in favor of the v2 pull tools.
- [`SupportedTools`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/server.go#L64-L70), [`ToolSchemas`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/server.go#L121-L181), and [`DispatchTool`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/server.go#L185-L229) updated in [server.go](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/server.go) supporting both canonical underscore names and dot-separated aliases.

### Tests
- [tools_test.go](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools_test.go): Comprehensive tests covering `memory.brief`, alias resolution, `memory.why`, `memory.search`, `memory.history`, `memory.note`, options/setters, and exposure ledger recording.
- [server_test.go](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/server_test.go): Schema validation and tool dispatching tests for all pull tools.
